(2) A man with shoulder-length curly hair wearing a teal shirt and a brown leather-detailed apron appears. He is behind a counter and hands a brown paper shopping bag to the woman. He uses hand gestures and points with two fingers while his mouth moves in a speaking motion. (3) The woman holds the brown bag close to her chest, looking expectantly at the man with a wide smile. The man smiles back initially, then his expression shifts to one of confusion and uncertainty as the camera cuts back and forth between them. (4) The man points upward with one hand while continuing to talk. The woman's smile disappears, replaced by an annoyed expression. She abruptly turns around and walks away from the counter toward the back of the room, passing large potted plants. (5) The man is shown holding a smartphone in his hands, looking down at the screen. A white text overlay resembling a social media review appears on the screen. He looks up at the camera with a shocked expression, his mouth wide open as if shouting. (6) The video transitions to a vibrant green graphic screen featuring a triangular logo with a slice of cake, followed by a search bar and social media handle text.
